items.title: Hoax bomb threats target European airlines and airports for second time in a week
items.summary: At least 21 flights across Europe are affected in what the UK government calls a "malicious hoax threat".

items.title: Who could be behind hoax bomb threats to European air travel?
items.summary: There is no hard evidence so far linking airline bomb threats to Russia, Iran or any proxy groups.

items.title: California governor commutes sentences for state's 548 death row inmates
items.summary: California has historically had the largest population of people on death row in the US.

items.title: French protests see numbers surge as unions join strikes over high cost of living
items.summary: The interior ministry estimates 600,000 people joined protests across France, while the unions say the number was far higher.

items.title: Paraguay President Santiago Peña resigns after bank collapse
items.summary: The move follows a bank collapse and after the lower house of congress voted in favour of pursuing an impeachment trial against him.

items.title: Eight killed in series of shootings in western Turkey
items.summary: Victims are found in several locations in three separate vehicles, according to local reports.
